name: Azurea Juncture
source:
Dearest mother and father...

My flight ran into a bit of trouble and I think it'll take a while for me to return home. Of course, by a bit of trouble, I actually mean a lot of trouble. And by a while, I actually meat that I may not be able to come back at all.

Why, you ask? Well, there was a pair of heavily armed hijackers, and a suicide bomber that managed to get get past airport security. Strangely enough, the hijackers and the suicide bomber had conflicting interests, spending roughly an hour arguing where they were going to crash the plane.

Needless to say, the plane was destroyed after they finished arguing, I'm pretty sure everyone that was unfortunate enough to have been a passenger of that flight is gone as well.

I don't know how many days have passed that incident and I don't particularly care. I somehow survived and ended up in a cabin with a sentient houseplant.

[From [url=https://levity.itch.io/azurea-juncture]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
亲爱的爸爸妈妈……

我的航班遇到了一点麻烦，恐怕要过一阵子才能回家。当然，我说“一点麻烦”，其实是很大的麻烦；我说“过一阵子”，其实是可能再也回不去了。

你们问为什么？机场安检竟然让两名全副武装的劫机犯和一名自杀式炸弹袭击者混了进来。奇怪的是，劫机犯和自杀式炸弹袭击者的目的彼此冲突，花了大约一个小时争论究竟要把飞机撞向哪里。

不用说，争论结束后飞机被毁了。我想，那趟航班上所有不幸成为乘客的人，大概也都死了。

我不知道事故发生后过去了多少天，也不太在意。我不知怎么活了下来，最后来到一间小屋里，和一株拥有意识的室内植物待在一起。

（来源：[url=https://levity.itch.io/azurea-juncture]itch.io[/url]）
